source_row.rationale: Prolonged fever (5+ days) combined with conjunctival injection (without discharge), rash, extremity changes (swelling, redness), and strawberry tongue are classic features of Kawasaki disease, a systemic vasculitis of childhood requiring prompt recognition and treatment (typically IVIG), given the significant risk of coronary artery aneurysms if left untreated.
source_row.source_detail: Diagnostic clinical features and coronary-artery complication risk; StatPearls 2026 edition; accessed 2026-08-14.
